description: Indus Motor Company Limited (IMC) is a joint venture between certain companies of the House of Habib of Pakistan, Toyota Motor Corporation and Toyota Tsusho Corporation of Japan, incorporated in 1989. It manufactures and markets Toyota brand vehicles in Pakistan, including the Corolla and Yaris in the passenger car segment, Hilux in light commercial vehicles, and Fortuner and Corolla Cross in the SUV segment. Its manufacturing facility and offices are on a 109.5-acre site at Port Qasim, Karachi.
